description:
It's finally here, the disc brake version of our iconic single speed cross machine.

Like it's cantilever breathren, the Nature Boy Disc carries all of the AC hallmarks that you've come to expect: beautiful lugged crown fork, classic paint, custom dropouts, and signature headbadge. It has our proven race inspired geometry, but since we're big fans of riding your cross bike everyday we've built in additional features to make it more versatile: the capability to fit large tires as well as the ability to add fenders should you desire them.

We are particularly proud of our new single speed disc dropout as it solves our main frustration with dropouts of this style: where do you position the brake caliper for optimum performance? The answer was to develop a proprietary system where the tension screw is used to pull the caliper mount into the correct position. Just loosen up everything, use the tensioner to achieve desired chain slack and tighten it all back up. No more guesswork, just reliable braking performance.

If you're interested in learning more about the design of the dropout, do make sure you read Anna's blog series on it's development, links can be found at the bottom of this page.

For racing, cruising trails, gravel, or daily commuting, the disc brakes and single speed setup provide unmatched control and reliability.

Signature Disc Single Speed Dropouts: Our new single speed disc single dropout perfectly aligns the caliper when you dial in the adjustment screws

Cross Race Geometry: This bike was designed to go real fast off road. It features aggressive yet traditional cyclocross racing geometry and goes like heck

Tire clearance: You can fit 38’cs in this bad boy front and rear, no problem. If you’re running fenders it’ll clear 35’s.

ED Finish: The entire bike is E.D. coated inside and out. E.D. coating not only improves the quality and durability of the paint, but is the best rust preventative that we can apply.

Fender Compatible: We hope you ride this bike in all conditions all year long, so with that in mind we added fender mounts.
